purpose: Independent acceptance plan for the local GRE mock-exam module; this file does not claim tests passed.

facts: Current format beginning September 22, 2023: five sections, 118 minutes.
Verbal: 12 questions in 18 minutes and 15 questions in 23 minutes.
Quant: 12 questions in 21 minutes and 15 questions in 26 minutes.
Verbal and Quant may appear in either order after Issue.
Within the current section, candidates may navigate, mark, review, and change answers.
An on-screen calculator is available for Quant.
The real exam is section-adaptive; local uncalibrated questions cannot reproduce ETS adaptive calibration.
The shorter exam has no scheduled ten-minute break.
Unscheduled test-center breaks do not stop the timer absent approved accommodations.
Raw correct counts are transformed using equating and section difficulty.
The local trainer must not label a guessed 130–170 conversion as an official score.

testScope: Real local bank, no generated question fixtures added to production data
55 total prompts including 54 objective items and one Issue task
Exact five section counts/timings and 118-minute budget
All selected objective items have verified answers and intact question formats
Issue first; same-measure section 1 precedes section 2
Change answer, mark, review only current section, section transition locks prior section
TC whole-item grading, SE exact pair, RC sentence selection, numeric fraction, DI assets
No answer or explanation shown during exam
Auto-advance at deadline, refresh does not reset timer, elapsed closed-page time catches up
Essay draft auto-save and final result synchronization
Omitted objective questions count against raw accuracy denominator
No invented scaled or AWA score
Finished exam archive and progress export/import without duplicated attempts
Old RC notes, bookmarks, and histories preserved
Mobile layout and no uncaught browser errors
